name: flutter-adk-ui-builder
description: Builds cross-platform Flutter AI chat, developer studio, workflow, voice, and evaluation UIs using package:flutter_adk/flutter_adk.dart (iOS, Android, Web/WASM, macOS, Windows, Linux). Covers turnkey views (AdkChatView, AdkDevStudioView, AdkSplitPaneView, AdkAgentManagementView, AdkSmartFormView, showAdkChatBottomSheet), 7 reactive controllers (AdkChatController, AdkWorkflowController, AdkVoiceController, AdkSessionController, AdkSmartFormController, AdkAgentLoggerController, AdkAgentManagerController), specialized tool/usage/eval cards (AdkUsageMonitorCard, AdkContextWindowMeter, AdkSkillToolCard, AdkFileEditCard, AdkShellCommandCard, AdkWebPageCard, AdkComputerActionCard, AdkCompactionSummaryCard, AdkReflectRetryBanner, AdkMultiRunEvalCard), AdkTheme & AdkCardStyle customization, AdkStorageSessionService, and UI utilities (AdkFormatters, AdkEventStreamUtils). Use when building or customizing Flutter AI agent UIs.
